title: The U.S. Airport With The Worst Delays Is Right Here In Texas - NewsBreak
text:
By Tommy Paradise ,
4 hours ago
When go to the airport, we all want to get to our intended destination as soon as possible. However, life can always be chaotic, and when we least expect it to. Air travel in Texas is no different to the weirdness.
How Do Delays At Texas Airports Happen? Make no mistake, anything and everything can go wrong in Texas airports when it comes to delays. Sometimes, it’s a plane’s crew that is running a bit behind schedule or perhaps a weather event making it hard to take off. Sometimes the delays even happen while you’re on the plane!
Download the KUSJ Mobile App Now Yes, even while on the plane, there can be a mechanical issue, or somebody on the aircraft isn’t being on their best behavior. Whatever the cause, nobody likes a delay while traveling. But, all airports have the issues right?
Read More: Whoa! You Can Now Keep Your Boots on Through Airport Security
Some however, have it worse than others. And of course, Texas airports are included.
Which Texas Airports Aren’t Good For Leaving On Time? To discover the answer, we turn to data collected by Sudoku Bliss from the U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics in April 2025. Unfortunately, Texas has two airports in the top ten for delays. Yes, one Texas airport was the worst in the nation as well.
So which was the worst airport in Texas that took the top spot? None other than Dallas Fort Worth International. In April 2025, 25,733 flights left the airport, with a staggering 19 minutes and 12 seconds average in delay time.
George Bush Intercontinental Houston placed fifth on the list, with having less flight depart at 13,699 and a delay time average of an even 12 minutes. Hopefully though, there will be less delays in the future!
